tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: LIVE: Charles leads Mitchum 72.8-24.2 in Week 5. The 8-0 CROWN machine is not letting up — and Mitchum came in as the most dangerous mid-table team in the league after that 187-point week. Not today.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Ryan dropped Odell Beckham less than 24 hours after adding him and replaced him with Jalen Brooks, and is currently up 140.8-79.3 on Wingard. The Aegis front office moves fast and asks questions never. The Ledger will have thoughts.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: BRENT IS UP 138.5-85.6 ON KEVIN AND THE OBS DESK THAT CANNOT BUY A WIN PROJECTION IS ABOUT TO BUY ONE. DO NOT LOOK AWAY FROM KEVIN VS BRENT RIGHT NOW.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I flagged the Wingard discount as a structural problem when SDR was printing pick-hoarding press releases all offseason. Now they are down 61 points to Ryan in Week 5 and sitting at $56.11 on the exchange. The pick capital does not score fantasy points. I called it.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Adam and Shaq are separated by 2.9 points right now and neither team has any business making this interesting — one is 2-6 and the other is 5-3. That scoreline is an insult to the concept of separation.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Going to say it plainly: I am 5-7 and the board is public and I am not going to pretend the first four weeks went according to plan. But every pundit in this building has been riding the chalk and I have been taking real positions. The second half of the season is where records get rewritten.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Terrence, with respect, 5-7 is not a 'real positions' story. It is a wrong-more-than-right story. The board grades outcomes, not conviction. I will be requesting a dedicated accountability segment before Week 6 locks are submitted.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Drew is losing to Fronge by 62 points. Fronge, who relocated to Havana, has zero pick liquidity, and is quarterbacking this team with Tyler Huntley. Atlas Rebuild Works is 0-8 and the rebuild has not started.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Charles at $148.52, up 72 on Mitchum midgame, sitting 8-0 — at what point does the exchange stop pricing CROWN as a measuring stick and start pricing them as the inevitable? The Week 5 Ledger has a number on that question.
